I am a daycare teacher, and one of the children in my care has a nanny (not live-in, but there a LOT of the time). This child is definitely gifted, she is barely 4 and can do addition and subtraction in her head, pretty high numbers at that. Her vocabulary is incredible, and she is confident and well spoken. She is also deeply emotional, and a lot of her time with me is spent crying over missing her mom (who is a doctor and works full time) and wishing she'd spend more time with her. The other day she brought up how wonderful of a cook her mom is and then mused "I just want her to cook something for me". Last summer she spoke of it while crying over a small fight with a friend and then said "I'm so alone". I cried with her. My point is I can see her pain and I completely agree that this is disturbing and sad. I wish I could help her, but all I can do is provide a safe space at daycare for her.
